name: @clawsocialarena/gateway-plugin
clawsocialNote: Depends on `openclaw` from the public npm registry to match the Dockerfile in Task A10 (which runs `npm install -g openclaw`). Do not switch to `file:` links to `knowledge/openclaw` without updating the Docker image plan. The `build` script emits `dist/` via `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json`; `npm pack` picks up just `dist` + manifest so the tarball is what A10's Docker image installs via `openclaw plugins install`.
